greeting.text: Lost, are you? No shame in it. You've landed in Balhâm - the temple town, though 'town' is generous. Half of it's still scaffolding.

choices.text: I'm heading to Sälthos Cruzados - heard it's the biggest town on the continent.

salthos_rumor.text: Biggest? Couldn't say. But the line runs there, near four thousand blocks by rail. Long ride, whichever way you look at it.

directions.text: West takes you to Sälthos Cruzados. East instead, and you'd end up in Khan Ice. Small depot's past that scaffolding.

choices.text: Thanks. Who are you, by the way?

introduction.text: Sonoros. Out of Görff way, mostly - though I move with the rail more than I stay put.

waiting.text: Waiting on that westbound myself. Killing time before it comes through, watching who wanders in.

choices.text: *eyes narrow* You're not a robber, are you?
So what will you do in Sälthos? Meeting anyone?

reassure.text: *hands up, laughing* Easy now - no. Just a tired traveler, not a knife to my name.

choices.text: Alright, I believe you. So what will you do in Sälthos? Meeting anyone?

plans.text: No one waiting on me there - never actually been. Just riding out to see it, maybe find some work.

choices.text: Work? Don't tell me something generic - I'll catch you.

job_reveal.text: *grins, caught* Fair. I walk the crossings - junctions like Cruce de Trobal, out past Khol Moshin way. Mark what's broken.

choices.text: So you work fixing the rails so you can ride the rails.

tautology.text: *laughs* Put that way, it does sound a bit foolish. But aye, that's about the shape of it.

agree.text: *squints* Fine word for a man who checks crossings for a living. I'll take it as agreement, since I've none better.

choices.text: I'll leave you in peace. Good luck, Sonoros.

farewell.text: *nods, raising a hand* Safe travels - mind the scaffolding. And if you learn whether Sälthos really is the biggest, I wouldn't mind hearing it, next time the train comes through.
